component.name: Myna
component.summary: Local, offline speech-to-text for the desktop

description.p: Myna provides local, offline speech-to-text for the Linux desktop. Activate dictation with a hotkey, speak, and the transcript is typed into the focused application via IBus. Audio is captured by this app; the inference backend has no microphone access. Nothing leaves the machine and no audio is persisted.
This Flatpak bundle includes the default faster-whisper inference server and desktop integration out of the box.

p.em: Note: This is an unofficial community Flatpak package and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Canonical Ltd.
